associations.name: Algonquin
associations.associationType: Historical homeland and continuing cultural connection
associations.period: Historical territory described on the current heritage-river page; inspected 2026-10-21
associations.evidenceNote: The Canadian Heritage Rivers System's Ottawa River, Ontario page identifies the Ontario heritage-river segment as the cultural heartland of the Algonquin people. Its plaque text describes the Ottawa River as flowing through Algonquin Traditional Territory and names Kitchisippi. Used for an Ontario regional connection only, not a claim over the entire province or an adjudication of modern land claims. The actual page was read, including Designation and Plaque Text; community-site and Natural Resources Canada requests failed and were not substituted as inspected evidence.

associations.name: Haida
associations.associationType: Continuing specific community and government connection
associations.period: Joint community/provincial publication dated April 14, 2024; geography inspected 2026-10-21
associations.evidenceNote: The Council of the Haida Nation's joint release locates Haida Gwaii off the northern coast of British Columbia, identifies the Council and its stewardship mandate, and describes the continuing Haida relationship with Haida Gwaii. This record uses the explicit place/community connection, not later legal-status conclusions. It covers Haida Gwaii and does not subsume the separate Kaigani Haida jurisdiction in Alaska or imply Haida presence throughout British Columbia.

unresolved: Additional Algonquin connections in Quebec and Haida connections in Alaska require their own scoped inspected evidence; not inferred from this batch.
